message: Server 'https://ec2.aws.com' has no x-fern-server-name, so Fern ignores it. The document has no top-level `servers` either, so the SDK has no URL for POST /ec2/boot and callers must pass a base URL. Add top-level servers and name operation- and path-level servers with x-fern-server-name.

Server 'https://staging.ec2.aws.com' has no x-fern-server-name, so Fern ignores it. The document has no top-level `servers` either, so the SDK has no URL for POST /ec2/boot and callers must pass a base URL. Add top-level servers and name operation- and path-level servers with x-fern-server-name.
